ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. Online scheduled class sessions require that each student have high speed internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions. Weekly virtual class sessions in Elluminate course delivery system. One required Saturday lab on the Urbana campus on April 2nd, from 9:30 am to 4 pm. No class March 23rd (UIUC spring break).
ns2:section.sectionFeeAmount: OCE Tuition $343.00 per Bill Hour, and OCE Fees $50.00 per Bill Hour.
